---
title: "Stata"
description: >-
  Where the paper's Stata code will be published and what it needs.
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("_common.R")
do_files <- link_or_text(
  vars$code$stata,                                                            # set once the do-files are published
  "Download the do-files",                                                    # the link text from then on
  "The do-files will be published on this page once they have been cleaned up"  # what the page says until then
)
```

The paper's regressions and several of its tables and figures are estimated in Stata. `r do_files`. The do-files read
the contracts table of [the database](data.qmd#part-core) and Compustat data from WRDS, which is licensed and not
published ([what needs WRDS](reproduce.qmd#what-needs-wrds)).
